title: Efficient Neural Network Architectures for Vehicle Type Classification Using VTID2
description: A content-audited, leakage-aware and efficiency-focused study of vehicle type classification on the VTID2 image dataset. Compares an MLP baseline, a Standard CNN, an efficient depthwise-separable CNN and an efficient CNN with Squeeze-and-Excitation, with multi-seed evaluation, paired bootstrap uncertainty, computational-efficiency benchmarking, ablation and Grad-CAM explainability.
